description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 04.07.2022 to 10.07.2022.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the determination of new currency exchange rates for customs duties and charges by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it names an individual (Major General G. V. Ravipriya), this is in the context of exercising statutory authority rather than a personnel appointment or government structural change, so government Types 1-3 do not apply.
